content.text:
The best composition I found is index 1 (Sb fraction 0.195), with an EQE of **0.0215%**. I've submitted it as the answer.

I used all 5 EQE measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.150 | 0.0144 |
| **1** | **0.195** | **0.0215** |
| 4 | 0.324 | 0.0098 |
| 14 | 0.502 | 0.00093 |
| 22 | 0.661 | 0.00045 |

- **Trend:** EQE rises by more than an order of magnitude toward the lead-rich end. It peaks near Sb ≈ 0.2 and drops off on both sides of index 1.
- **Known phases score low:** the compositions near Pb2Sb2O7 (Sb 0.5) and PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.67) are among the weakest under the 2.1 eV light.
- **Uncertainty:** index 2 (Sb 0.256) was never measured, so the true peak could sit slightly above 0.195. I spent the last measurement on index 1 instead because it was closer to the best result at that point.
- **XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I haven't checked which crystal phase is behind the best result.
